{{Quote|According to the information you downloaded from Jzoro, the Elite Council has two bases outside of town. Start with the one south of town.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />}}
The '''First Elite Council Bunker''' was a bunker located on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It served as the headquarters of the [[Chirq Council]].

==History==
{{Quote|I have been unable to infiltrate the bunker, and therefore unable to hinder the Chirq Council's research into biological weapons. I request your assistance. Please invade this bunker, retrieve whatever data you can find on their biological weapon capabilities, and take down some of their chemists.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Teniel Waray|Waray]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FCCBF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Fighting Chirq Council Biological Warfare|Corellia}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the First Elite Council Bunker was one of the two bunkers that served as headquarters of the Chirq Council, along with the [[Second Elite Council Bunker]]. They were both located in isolated areas near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] and heavily defended. Four of the nine Chirq Council [[Elite Council|elite councilors]] were based in the First Elite Council Bunker, [[Rallyn Secura]], [[Mathazar Zayet]], [[Crale Forte]] and [[Atlan Dubreas]], while the five others were based in the Second Elite Council Bunker.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" /> The First Elite Council Bunker was also used by Chirq Council chemists for the development of [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]].<ref name="SWG:FCCBF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Fighting Chirq Council Biological Warfare|Corellia}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] infiltrated a CorSec agent in [[Jzoro Quanera]]'s Chirq Council cell in Doaba Guerfel. From Quanera's database, the CorSec obtained the identity of the nine elite councilors and the locations of their two secret headquarters.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Moving Up|Corellia}}</ref> The Corsec first raided the First Second Elite Council Bunker. CorSec forces assaulted the buildings and eliminated most of the guards.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" /> Following orders from CorSec [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Teniel Waray]], the CorSec troops also collected data about the Chirq Council bioweapons and killed several chemists.<ref name="SWG:FCCBF" /> They also found in the bunker the body of [[Vryim Raeth]], an innocent man assassinated by the Council.<ref name="SWG:FCRhV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Cara Raeth's husband, Vryim|Corellia}}</ref> The CorSec eventually killed half of the elite councilors in the depths of the bunker. After the death of all the other elite councilors during the subsequent CorSec assault on the Second Elite Council Bunker, the Chirq Council splintered.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The First Elite Council Bunker appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The First Elite Council Bunker was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
